content.title: Where Durability Meets Design
content.paragraph1: A professionally installed concrete garage floor provides the strength, durability, and clean finish your home deserves. Using quality concrete, proper reinforcement, and expert finishing techniques, Maxima Concrete delivers floors built to support heavy vehicles, withstand daily traffic, and resist wear over time. Whether your garage is used for parking, storage, or a workspace, we build floors designed for long-lasting performance.
content.paragraph2: Every garage floor is installed with proper site preparation, precision finishing, and attention to every detail to ensure a smooth, level surface built to last. Designed for low maintenance and long-term reliability, our concrete floors provide the performance and quality homeowners can count on for years to come.

items.question: How long does a concrete garage floor last?
items.answer: A properly installed garage floor can last 30 years or more, standing up to vehicles, tools, and daily wear.

items.question: Does concrete crack in cold weather?
items.answer: Our fiber-reinforced, 6.5-bag mix and wire mesh reinforcement minimize cracking, even through harsh Ohio winters.

items.question: Can I make my garage floor look decorative?
items.answer: Yes. We offer sealed, colored, and finished options that resist stains and are easy to keep clean.

items.question: How do I maintain my concrete garage floor?
items.answer: Sweep and clean regularly, wipe up oil or chemical spills promptly, and reseal every few years to protect the surface.
